annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the changes in the "Missing Step" metric with respect to different x-axis values, comparing two conditions labeled as "w.o. extension" and "extension". The x-axis is labeled with no specific name, follows a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4, and has tick marks at regular intervals of 1 unit. The y-axis is labeled "Missing Step", also on a linear scale, ranging from 0.840 to 0.860, with tick marks at intervals of 0.005. The first line representing "w.o. extension" is blue with circular markers and a dashed line style. It starts at approximately 0.861 on the y-axis when x is 0 and decreases steadily to about 0.838 when x is 3 and 4. The second line, labeled "extension", is orange with triangular markers and a solid line style. It begins similarly around 0.862 on the y-axis for x equal to 0, and similarly decreases, but at a slightly less rate aft x = 1, reaching around 0.842 by the time x is 4. Both lines exhibit a consistent decline across the x-axis. They don't intersect each other. A legend is given top right.
